baseSignature.description: The original function signature before arguments were partially applied.

language.description:
A "language" of this lambda. I.e. how #implementation should be interpreted. This must be one of the constant
values from {@link Lambda.Language}.

implementation.description: An implementation of this this lambda. Depends on #language.

environment.description: Extra settings to establish in the target execution environment before execution.

actionRequirement.description:
The minimal action requirement for this lambda to execute. This should generally be null, to make the lambda as
widely useful as possible.
